questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code decides whether the actor may change another member's role? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A user with the billing role calls the endpoint to change a member's role to billing. What is the response?
The sole owner of an org tries to change their own role to admin. What happens?
choices: 409 last_owner, and the role is unchanged
204, and the org is left with no owner
204, because owners can always change roles

questions.prompt: Someone who is not a member of org X sends a role change for X. Why is the outcome 404 rather than 403?
choices: Because the target user lookup fails first
Because the actor lookup returns null and the service throws NotFoundError, hiding whether the org exists
Because the route checks org existence before calling the service
Because ROLE_RANK has no entry for non-members
